The first polls returncode without awaiting anything. The second pipes stdout and repeatedly awaits readline; after EOF, immediate completion can monopolize the coroutine while process-exit callbacks remain undispatched. The reporter observes repeated empty lines and no parent returncode completion on Windows 3.11.
python--cpython--127661.upstream_outcome: Closed as not planned. Contributor identifies lack of cooperative yielding in the first example and provides sleep(0) guidance. Later contributor reports the second unchanged example works on3.12andabove,but not3.11,which was in security-fixes-onlymode. No linked commit or fix was locally validated.
python--cpython--127661.test_limit: Source review only. No new binary/dependency readiness check, installation, build, native program, supervisor, capture, policy probe, or live session handle. Previously confirmed Linux 3.10.12 is context, not readiness for this issue.
